notes.subject: arĩranĩ
notes.rationale: ממזרים (nyiitwo kuuma mazeri, 'acio arĩranĩ') — ta kĩhũtho: 'mĩthemba ya rũgongo' (KJV 'north') kana gũcokia mũhiano wa kũbararanithia maũndũ (YLT 'scatterings').

notes.subject: ממזרים
notes.rationale: Kiugo gĩkĩ kĩonekana tanakĩ hĩndĩ ĩno yothe thĩinĩ wa kĩrĩndĩ kĩu kĩa mn.

notes.subject: cimbicine-inĩ
notes.rationale: החדר nĩ 'cimbici wa mũndũ-wa-thĩ'; ta KJV gĩtuĩka 'south' (rũgongo-rwa) — gĩcunjĩ kĩu kĩarĩ kĩũgĩrĩire ndawa ya ma.

translation: Kuuma cimbicine-inĩ ĩgũũkaga kĩhuho kĩnene, na kuuma arĩranĩ ĩgũũkaga thanda.
